verdict.rationale: Semgrep Supply Chain docs explicitly state it can 'generate reports and software bills of materials (SBOM) that provide a complete inventory of your open source components,' directly supporting the story, but there is no format specificity (SPDX/CycloneDX) or independent/hands-on evidence of the SBOM export actually working. missing for 10: confirmation of SPDX/CycloneDX format support, CLI command/example for SBOM generation, container image scanning for SBOM, and independent corroboration of the feature working in practice.
